userStories.title: Make the login page Mobile-Friendly
acceptanceCriteria: Can be accessed and used on a mobile device without layout issues
All elements are appropriately sized and spaced for touch interaction
Login form is centered and readable on small screens
Login feature works as now on web layout, with no new issues

userStories.title: Fix login page error messages
userStories.description: Fix login page error messages: Unexpected token '<', "<!DOCTYPE "... is not valid JSON, make it more user friendly and informative
acceptanceCriteria: When a user enters incorrect login credentials, they should see a clear and concise error message indicating that the username or password is incorrect, instead of a generic JSON parsing error.
